papers_found.title: Moira: Language-driven Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Pair Trading
papers_found.relevance_notes: LLM-based semantic pair selection (high-level) + RL execution (low-level). No hard OOS numbers. Novel framing relevant to H200/pairs family. Staged as H297 proposal.

papers_found.title: Dynamic Multi-Pair Trading Strategy in Cryptocurrency Markets with Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers_found.relevance_notes: PPO+LSTM crypto pairs trading. Filter-then-rank methodology and deterministic shielding are useful concepts. Crypto-only; limited direct applicability to equity rotation pipeline.

papers_found.title: Enhancing Post Earnings Announcement Drift Measurement with Large [LLMs]
papers_found.relevance_notes: PDF unreadable. Title suggests LLM-enhanced PEAD measurement. Could not extract OOS results. FinBERT achieves 57-58% accuracy on earnings direction. No actionable numbers obtained.

papers_found.title: Machine Learning Enhanced Multi-Factor Quantitative Trading: A Cross-Sectional Portfolio Optimization Approach with Bias Correction
papers_found.relevance_notes: 213-factor engine, A-shares OOS Sharpe 1.63 (2022-2024). Key finding: tradability mask removes 18% IC inflation and +0.44 Sharpe from non-tradable prices. US analog relevant for stock-level strategies. Staged as wiki update for survivorship-bias.md.

papers_found.title: Agentic Trading: When LLM Agents Meet Financial Markets
papers_found.relevance_notes: CRITICAL: survey of 19 LLM trading studies finds only 2 had valid IS/OOS protocols, 1 reported transaction costs, 0 achieved R3 reproducibility. Validates George's backtesting discipline. Staged as wiki update for design-principles.md.

papers_found.title: prediction-market-analysis (GitHub dataset repo)
papers_found.relevance_notes: 36GB historical Polymarket+Kalshi data with cleaned order books and resolution data. High value for backtesting H185 (CPI nowcasting) and cross-platform arb. Staged as wiki update for other-platforms.md.

papers_found.title: pmxt — Unified Prediction Market API
papers_found.relevance_notes: CCXT-style unified API for Polymarket, Kalshi, etc. Enables cross-platform arb scanning. 1.2k stars. Staged as wiki update for other-platforms.md.

summary: Best find: Agentic Trading survey (2605.19337) — validates our backtesting rigor vs industry LLM papers. Practical finds: prediction-market-analysis dataset (36GB PM history) and pmxt unified PM API directly actionable for prediction markets work. Moira pairs trading (2605.01954) staged as H297 seed — LLM semantic pair selection is a novel approach after H200/ETF pairs were exhausted. Mask-first bias correction (2507.07107) extends survivorship-bias wiki with a new US-applicable concept.
